steps.en: Unpack the single binary and start a ready-to-use S3 store
steps.zh: 解开单个二进制，直接起一个可用的 S3 服务

steps.en: Runs master, volume server, filer, S3 gateway and admin UI in one process
steps.zh: 在一个进程里跑 master、卷服务、filer、S3 网关与管理界面

steps.en: Point any S3 client at :8333 and start uploading
steps.zh: 任意 S3 客户端指向 :8333 就能上传
steps.code: aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:8333 s3 cp README.md s3://my-bucket/

steps.en: Packs small files into append-only volumes with a 16-byte in-memory index per blob
steps.zh: 小文件打包进追加写卷，每个 blob 在内存里只留 16 字节索引

steps.en: Add capacity by starting another volume server against the master
steps.zh: 容量不够时，再起一个卷服务指向 master

value.en: Billions of small objects at one disk read each — you stop paying a per-file metadata tax or reshuffling data to add capacity
value.zh: 十亿级小对象、每个只读一次盘：不再为每个文件付元数据税，扩容量也不用搬数据

sources: https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs#one-command (weed mini -dir=./data starts an S3 object store; endpoint http://localhost:8333; aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:8333 s3 cp README.md s3://my-bucket/)
https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs#scale-out (weed volume -dir=/data -master=<master_host>:9333; capacity is a volume server, gateways are stateless)
https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs#fast (one disk read per blob; 16-byte in-memory index entry per blob; 40 bytes of metadata per file; append-only volume files)
https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs#one-command (the same process also runs the master, a volume server, the filer, WebDAV, the Iceberg REST catalog, and the Admin UI)
